meta.title: Revising while a counter offer is pending

plan.title: Vendor bid revision blocked by pending counter offer

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Responses tab containing Vendor A's existing bid.
Open the buyer's comparison grid for Vendor A's bid before sending the counter offer.
Send a buyer counter offer on Vendor A's bid, leaving it pending.
Verify the buyer's grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Open the separate Vendor A portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's pricing round and bid sheet as Vendor A.

args.because: You have a counter offer pending on this bid

steps.note: Attempt to revise the price and verify Procol refuses it because the counter offer is still pending.
